required_completeness_dimensions.confirmation_rule: A stable subject/donor key must link every retained intervention, visit, assay result, and adverse event inside one study; study accession or arm name is not a donor key.
Per-subject intervention identity, route, timing, and dose must be present; public arm labels establish only a contrast and therefore count as partial.
The same donor must have an actual baseline and at least one post-intervention response time; a study-level planned-visit count is partial only.
At least one public Flow Cytometry or CyTOF result count must be positive, and authenticated rows must later support the frozen target phenotype.
At least one public Luminex xMAP, ELISA, Meso Scale Discovery ECL, or Cytokine Bead Array result count must be positive, and authenticated rows must later support a frozen cytokine panel.
At least one public Flow Cytometry or CyTOF result count must be positive, and a phenotype distinct from the target must be frozen before modeling.

Subject-linked adverse-event rows, including severity, causality/relation, and study-day timing, must be available in the same study; a title mentioning adverse events is not evidence for another study.

status_vocabulary.confirmed_public: The unauthenticated search snapshot contains positive row-count evidence for this assay layer.
status_vocabulary.partial_public_detail_locked: The public search snapshot establishes study-level structure, but not the required per-subject linkage.
status_vocabulary.unavailable_authenticated_detail: The documented detail endpoint requires authentication and returned HTTP 401 in this capture; unavailable is not absent.
status_vocabulary.not_confirmed_zero_result_rows: The search snapshot names the assay method but reports zero result rows; the layer cannot count as available.
status_vocabulary.not_confirmed_method_absent: The search snapshot does not list a qualifying assay method; this is a public-screening rejection, not proof that no other data exist.

selection_rule.activation_ready_if: All seven completeness dimensions are confirmed within the same study and donor, with no cross-study borrowing and no cell-level donor leakage.
selection_rule.model_opening_rule: Do not open an outcome or fit a model until one candidate has authenticated donor, intervention/dose, actual visit, assay-result, and adverse-event rows and the target/guardrail panels are frozen.

safety_boundary: Retrospective metadata and data-readiness research only. No dose, vaccine, immunotherapy, clinical-control, or treatment recommendation; unavailable data never imply safety.
